You will need to navigate through the Linux operating system, use shell commands and produce a single integer as output. Ensure you navigate to the correct directory as specified below. Inside the "assignment" directory, there are multiple files - both text files (with `.txt` extension) and non-text files. 3. Your task is to find the total number of occurrences of the word "Linux" (case insensitive) in all the text files within this directory.
